description: Single-file habit tracker: habit CRUD with color/icon/schedule, daily check-off grid for the week, GitHub-style year heatmap per habit, current/longest streak computation, weekly goals with progress, stats dashboard, demo data, localStorage persistence.

criteria: habit_tracker_model_01.html is one self-contained habit tracker (no libraries): habits created and edited with name, color, icon or emoji and a weekly schedule of target days, a week grid where today and past days can be checked or unchecked, a GitHub-style year heatmap per habit built from real date math, current streak and longest streak computed from the schedule rather than naive day counting, weekly goal progress bars, a stats dashboard with completion rates per habit and per week, adding demo data on first run, and full localStorage persistence with date-robust serialization (no timezone drift). Streaks must survive month and year boundaries when computed.
